title: Requirement spec contract
description: The app's requirement-ID scheme for spec-traceability: where the spec lives, the ID kinds, and which files count as tests.

specDir.description: Repo-relative folder of the spec markdown files.

kinds.description: The ID kinds. A heading '<prefix><number> · <title>' is an entry of that kind.

prefix.description: 1-10 capital letters or digits starting with a letter, optionally ending in - or _.

traced.description: An entry of this kind marked 'Status: built' must be cited by a test or flow.

named.description: Citations of the form 'Title (ID)' are checked against the entry title and aliases.

requiredFields.description: Fields every entry of this kind carries; 'A|B' means either.

defaultStatus.description: The status of an entry without a Status line.

bareIn.description: Where a bare ID is read: everywhere (default for prefixes ending in - or _) or only in comments of code files.

sections.description: Check section citations (the word spec followed by a section number) against numbered section headings: true, false, or auto (only when the spec numbers its sections).

aliases.description: Extra names an entry may be cited by, per ID.

traceGlobs.description: Files whose citations trace an entry (tests and end-to-end flows). A glob without '/' matches a file name anywhere.

ignore.description: Extra globs check-spec-refs does not read.
